title: Stop duplicate orders after client retries
stopConditions: a workflow, permission, or Actions change is required
a public response field would change
a schema change beyond an additive migration is required
the same required check fails twice with the same failure signature

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Same key and payload within 24 hours returns the original order
acceptanceCriteria.provenBy: replays the original response across instances

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Same key with a different payload returns 409
acceptanceCriteria.provenBy: rejects a different payload for the same key

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Concurrent retries create exactly one order
acceptanceCriteria.provenBy: creates exactly one order under concurrent cross-instance retries

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Requests without a key preserve current behavior
acceptanceCriteria.provenBy: preserves baseline behavior without an idempotency key

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Raw keys and payloads are not logged
